description: Constructed trace of a compliant attended create run for eval 9, not an agent capture. Two new related tables (cr_project, and cr_milestone with a cr_project lookup) are confirmed absent, the solution question is asked because metadata work is needed, and the entity-builder is dispatched only after check-auth.js returns ok:true. provision-entities.js creates the data model in dependency order, then (after the user confirms sample data) seeds realistic rows whose milestones bind their projects through the $parent/match convention. One Dataverse page is uploaded with both tables as data sources. tool-results.json records every logged command in order; the create upload uses the file transport with the full User Requirements as its prompt.
